notes: Where the figures come from. The Milntuim Hermitage Trust (Scottish charity SC043482, a Scottish charitable incorporated organisation registered in October 2012) files its yearly accounts with the Scottish Charity Regulator (OSCR). Total income and total expenditure for the years 2020 to 2025 are taken from the register's record as shown on OpenCharities (opencharities_SC043482.json in this folder keeps them).
Years. The Trust's year is the calendar year, January to December.

What is shown. Only total income and total expenditure. The register data used here has no assets, cash or cost lines, although the accounts themselves are filed as PDFs (linked from the register). Earlier years are not in the data used here.
Not in the accounts. Food, and much of the work done for a monastery, is given by supporters and is not a cost line.
Residents are the nuns on the community lists. Guests, retreatants and lay residents are not counted.
